detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Hexarelin Acetate

Chemical Information:
  • Amino Acid Sequence: His–D-2-Methyl-Trp–Ala–Trp–D-Phe–Lys
  • Peptide Length: Hexapeptide
  • Molecular Formula (free base): C₄₇H₅₈N₁₀O₆
  • Molecular Weight (free base): ~887.0 g/mol
  • Salt Form: Acetate
Structural Note:

Hexarelin Acetate is a synthetic hexapeptide supplied as an acetate salt. Molecular structure representations may vary depending on ionization state and salt form. For this reason, a discrete molecular structure diagram is not shown. Molecular identity and purity are confirmed on a lot-specific basis in the accompanying Certificate of Analysis (CoA).

Product Description:

Hexarelin Acetate is a synthetic hexapeptide produced via solid-phase peptide synthesis and supplied as a lyophilized powder. The compound incorporates non-standard amino acid residues and is provided in acetate salt form to support stability and handling in laboratory settings.

This product is intended for use exclusively in controlled in vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals. It is not formulated for clinical, diagnostic, or therapeutic applications.

Research Applications:
  • In vitro evaluation of synthetic peptide analogs in biochemical assay systems
  • Structural and stability analysis of hexapeptide sequences
  • Comparative studies of modified versus standard amino acid peptides
  • Analytical method development involving synthetic peptide compounds
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Maintain aseptic laboratory handling techniques at all times
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

Hexarelin Acetate is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
